name: Alert for Betrayal
text: **Alert for Betrayal**: Some half-elves’ skepticism of apparent allies makes them cynical and stubborn. These half-elves gain a +2 racial bonus on saves against illusion spells and effects. Perception and Sense Motive are class skills for them. This racial trait replaces adaptability.
